observations: Two photos show the same dark console unit from slightly different angles, on a glass counter with a 'McSteve' branded bag beneath it.
Console has a flat, angular, stacked-panel design with a visible PlayStation button logo on the top panel in photo 0.
Surface shows visible scuffs, scratches and dust/smudges across the top panel.
No controller, cables, power brick, or box is visible in either photo.
Background shows unrelated phone/tablet boxes on shop shelving, consistent with a resale gadget shop, not the item itself.

read_from: photo 0 console shape and PlayStation logo

claims.claim: UK Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: Shape and logo in photo 0 are consistent with a PS4 Pro, but 'UK Used' (region/import history) cannot be confirmed from photos; no serial, label, or plug type shown.
No controller is visible in photo 0 or photo 1; only the console unit(s) are shown.

risks.risk: Console power-on and operational state unknown (could fail to boot, disc drive issue, overheating from wear visible).
risks.proof: Short video clip of console powered on, showing PS4 home screen or a game running.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / not confirmed functional

risks.risk: Storage/HDD capacity and whether it's original or swapped drive.
risks.proof: Photo of bottom label/sticker showing model number and storage size, or settings screen showing storage.
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest common capacity assumption

risks.risk: Claimed controller not actually included in the sale.
risks.proof: Photo showing the controller alongside the console, ideally powered/paired.

risks.risk: No cables (HDMI, power) shown, which are needed for use.
risks.proof: Photo of included accessories/cables laid out next to console.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage beyond scuffs (e.g., cracks, broken ports) not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of rear ports, underside vents, and disc slot.
risks.if_unproven: priced at visible cosmetic condition (used, scuffed) as worst case

proof_requests: Video of console powered on, loading a game or showing dashboard.
Photo of the actual controller alongside the console.
Close-up of rear port panel and disc slot for damage.
Photo of bottom label showing model/storage info.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Sony PS4 Pro console from its distinctive shape and logo, but functionality, included controller, and accessories are all unverified or contradicted by the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as a console-only, untested unit.
